name: Hong Kong Transport Department traffic snapshot cameras
short: Still images from Hong Kong road traffic cameras, refreshed every 2 minutes. Free, no key.
summary: Hong Kong's Transport Department publishes JPEG snapshots (320 x 240) from its roadside traffic cameras at a fixed URL per camera, plus an XML or CSV list with each camera's district, description and latitude/longitude. The listing says images update every 2 minutes. On 2026-11-06 (UTC) the sampled image's Last-Modified header was about 2 minutes before the call. Low resolution; a camera that is down returns a 'No Service' image.

tasks: current still image from a named road camera
list cameras with district, description, latitude and longitude

coverage.notes: Cameras grouped by region and district in the location list (for example Aberdeen Praya Road, Aberdeen Tunnel). The number of cameras was not counted.

delivery.basis: data.gov.hk dataset page: update frequency every 2 minutes. Live HEAD/GET 2026-11-06: image Last-Modified 18:18:58 GMT, response date 18:20:43 GMT.

latency.notes: Dataset page says 2 minutes; one image sampled at under 2 minutes. The page warned the service might be intermittently unavailable 2026-11-06 20:00 to 2026-11-07 00:00 (HKT?) for maintenance; timezone not stated on the excerpt read.

freshness.notes: A 'No Service' image is returned when a camera is down; 301 or 302 redirects can occur.

licensing.summary: Terms of data.gov.hk (v1.2): free for commercial and non-commercial use with clear source credit to the Government, the data owner and DATA.GOV.HK; as is, no warranty. The dataset page excerpt read states no separate licence. Images may show people and vehicles; the terms do not discuss privacy. Not stated whether AI training is allowed.

time.unknown: Image carries an HTTP Last-Modified header, not an on-image timestamp; clock handling not documented.

location.method: latitude and longitude per camera in Traffic_Camera_Locations_En.xml.
location.unknown: Camera coordinates are listed in the location file; not independently checked.

content.unknown: Low-resolution frame (320 x 240); no per-image quality flags.

human.unknown: Not applicable: automated instruments and official forecasts, not people.

application.unknown: No signing or attestation from instrument to API is documented.

camera.unknown: Frames are unsigned and unwatermarked; nothing proves which camera or moment beyond the file URL and Last-Modified.

corroboration.unknown: Nothing documented independently confirms individual readings.

endpoints.params: language variants En, Tc, Sc; XML or CSV

api.rate_limits: Not stated on the page read.
